cohort_total_n_excerpt: This included 1,294 incident, histologically confirmed prostate cancer cases below age 75 years admitted to major teaching and general hospitals in the areas under study, and 1,451 controls below age 75 years selected among patients admitted to the same hospitals as cases for a wide spectrum of acute nonneoplastic conditions not related to long-term modifications of diet.
reason: The abstract evaluates incident, histologically confirmed prostate cancer overall. It does not establish an analysis of aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal incident disease.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The risk of prostate cancer tended to decrease with increasing intake of retinol (OR=0.79 for the highest versus the lowest quintile of intake), carotene (OR=0.70), alpha-carotene (OR=0.85) and beta-carotene (OR=0.72), although the estimates were significant for carotene and beta-carotene only.
estimate_classifications.reason: The beta-carotene estimate is for prostate cancer overall.
